sources.title: Claude Fable \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: Claude Fable 5 is the highest-scoring model on FrontierBench, Cognition's frontier coding eval. It excels at long-horizon reasoning and generalizes to unfamiliar tools out of the box.

sources.title: Qwable-v1 Released as Claude Fable-5 Distillation
sources.snippet: Qwable-v1, an open-weights 35B model distilled from 4,659 surviving agentic-coding traces of Anthropic's briefly public Claude Fable-5 model, has been released.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 distilled — claudepractice
sources.snippet: Claude Fable 5 distilled Releasing Qwable-v1 - an open-weights Qwen3.6-35B-A3B distilled from Claude Fable-5, Anthropic's Mythos-class preview model that was briefly public for ~4days (2026-06-9 → 2026-06-12) before being suspended globally under U.S. export-control directives.
